opening.quote: Good afternoon, Tidewell Home, Ruud speaking. How can I help?
opening.comment: The agent gave both the company name and their own name in the opening turn, which meets the greeting requirement.

verification.quote: Agent: Fine. Give me the new address.
verification.comment: The agent changed the order without first confirming the caller's full name and the order number or postcode on the account; the caller only gave the order number after the agent had already moved on, so verification was skipped.

understanding.quote: Customer: Wasn't it already sent out yesterday? I got an email saying dispatched.
understanding.comment: The agent captured the address change request but brushed past the caller's concern that the order was already dispatched, which is the key issue for the caller.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: Yes, it was dispatched yesterday, but that doesn't matter, the courier will go to the new address.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Address changes are only possible before dispatch, so the agent wrongly promised the change would work after dispatch and gave an unsupported delivery timeline of 2 to 4 working days.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: Right, done, I've changed order 391827 to 22 Lindengracht.
process_compliance.comment: No hold occurred, so the hold steps do not apply; however, the agent should have followed the policy that address changes are only possible before dispatch and should not have processed this change.

communication.quote: Customer: Hi Ruud, I need to change the delivery address on my order. I've just moved and I'm really stressed about this, it's urgent.
communication.comment: The caller said they were stressed and that it was urgent, but the agent did not acknowledge this and replied only with 'Fine' and curt phrasing.

closing.quote: Agent: Thanks for calling Tidewell. Bye.
closing.comment: The agent closed politely but did not ask if there was anything else before the caller said no, and the 'anything else' question came only once, so this is partly met; the closing was abrupt and the next steps were not clearly confirmed.
